2. The Surface Coal/Lignite Gasification scheme (₹37,500 crore) supports up to 20% of plant cost, capped at ₹5,000 crore.

1. LNG is natural gas cooled to about −160°C, which shrinks its volume about 600 times.
2. LPG is lighter than air.
3. PNG supplied to homes through city gas networks has 85–95% methane.
4. CNG consists mainly of propane and butane.
How many of the above statements are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct as given in the notes; statement 2 is wrong – LPG (propane + butane) is heavier than air; it is LNG that is lighter than air; statement 4 is wrong – CNG is mainly methane (80–90%); propane and butane make up LPG.

x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct as given in the notes; statement 2 is wrong – organic-rich shale is the source rock; the cap rock is the impervious bed that seals the trap.
